title: Google is killing Assistant on phones September 4. Gemini is the only option left.
excerpt: Google confirmed Assistant on Android phones shuts down September 4, forcing all users to Gemini. Smartwatches, headphones, and Android Auto also affected. TVs get more time.
content_html:
TL;DR

Google confirmed Assistant on Android phones dies September 4, forcing everyone to Gemini. Smartwatches, headphones, and Android Auto also affected. TVs and built-in car systems transition later. No date for those.

Google confirmed in emails to users that Assistant on Android phones will shut down starting September 4, forcing everyone to Gemini. The process may take several weeks to complete, so holdouts may get a brief extension, but the direction is final. The original plan was to retire Assistant in late 2025. Google delayed to shore up Gemini’s capabilities. It now considers Gemini ready.

The shutdown extends beyond phones. Smartwatches, headphones, and cars using Android Auto will also lose Assistant and move to Gemini, since those devices connect through the phone for smart features. Most Google smart home devices have already transitioned. Android-powered TVs, set-top boxes, and vehicles with Google built-in are not included in this round and will transition later, with no date announced.

Older devices that do not meet Gemini’s minimum specs or users in regions where Gemini is not supported may keep Assistant longer, but virtually everyone else loses access within one to two months. Google rebuilt Search around AI-generated summaries and faced backlash for replacing a predictable system with an unpredictable one. The same tension applies here: Assistant was limited but reliable. Gemini is powerful but sometimes forgets it has access to a tool, goes on tangents, or misinterprets quick voice commands that Assistant handled consistently.

“Hey Google” now means talking to a generative AI chatbot instead of a rule-based assistant. For users who want to set a timer, play a song, or check the weather, Gemini is more capable than necessary and occasionally less reliable than what it replaces. A German court ruled Google liable for AI-generated content, and every voice interaction that Gemini handles differently from Assistant is a user experience change Google is imposing without consent. The alternative is to turn off voice control entirely.

content_html_zh:
TL;DR

谷歌确认 Android 手机上的 Assistant 将于 9 月 4 日终止，迫使所有人转向 Gemini。 智能手表、耳机和 Android Auto 也受到影响。 电视和内置汽车系统稍后过渡。 那些没有日期。

谷歌在发给用户的电子邮件中确认，Android 手机上的 Assistant 将从 9 月 4 日开始关闭，迫使所有人使用 Gemini。 该过程可能需要几周时间才能完成，因此坚持不懈的人可能会得到短暂的延期，但方向是最终的。 原计划是在 2025 年底让 Assistant 退休。 谷歌推迟了对 Gemini 能力的支持。 现在它认为双子座已经准备好了。

关闭范围不仅限于手机。 使用 Android Auto 的智能手表、耳机和汽车也将失去 Assistant 并转移到 Gemini，因为这些设备通过手机连接以实现智能功能。 大多数谷歌智能家居设备已经发生了转变。 Android 电视、机顶盒和内置 Google 的车辆不包括在这一轮中，并将在稍后过渡，但没有公布日期。

不符合 Gemini 最低规格的旧设备或不支持 Gemini 的地区的用户可能会保留 Assistant 更长时间，但几乎其他人都会在一到两个月内失去访问权限。 谷歌围绕人工智能生成的摘要重建了搜索，并因用不可预测的系统取代可预测的系统而面临强烈反对。 同样的压力也适用于此：助理虽然有限但可靠。 Gemini 功能强大，但有时会忘记它可以使用某个工具、偏离正题或误解 Assistant 始终处理的快速语音命令。

“Hey Google”现在意味着与生成式人工智能聊天机器人而不是基于规则的助手交谈。 对于想要设置计时器、播放歌曲或查看天气的用户来说，Gemini 的功能超出了必要范围，但有时不如它所取代的产品可靠。 德国法院裁定谷歌对人工智能生成的内容负责，而 Gemini 处理的每一次与 Assistant 不同的语音交互都是谷歌在未经同意的情况下强加的用户体验改变。 另一种方法是完全关闭语音控制。
